description: Supplementary information files for Supporting a self-sustained energy planning ecosystem: Lessons from Sierra Leone is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Loughborough University. Supplementary files for article Supporting a self-sustained energy planning ecosystem: Lessons from Sierra Leone The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development calls for the achievement of universal access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all. To fulfil this ambition, least developed countries need to mobilise enormous investments in a short amount of time. Coverage: Sierra Leone. The portal files it under the publisher Loughborough University. Its tags are Engineering, Human society. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
